package deal

import (
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/x509"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

// Writes capsule-viewer#237's parent-log-witness/v1 fixtures: today's
// capsulectl copy (which carries no chain since u225) with the holder's
// production parent-log-witness/v1 block put in by withHolderChain.
func TestViewer237Fixtures(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("VIEWER237_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("VIEWER237_OUT not set")
	}
	public, key, err := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	endpoint, _ := countingWitness(t)
	p := cadenceFixture(t, endpoint, public, "1h", "0s", 0)
	now := clockAt(t, time.Date(2026, 10, 4, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
	dealID := retailDeal(t)
	require.Equal(t, "ticked", dealRun(t, "tick")["state"])
	deliverAt(t, p, cadenceSize(t, p), key, time.Date(2026, 10, 4, 9, 0, 5, 0, time.UTC))
	write := func(name string) {
		dir := t.TempDir()
		copyPath := filepath.Join(dir, "copy.json")
		dealRun(t, "report", "--deal", dealID, "--bundle", copyPath)
		chained := withHolderChain(t, p, dealID, copyPath)
		requireParentWitness(t, mustRead(t, chained), "")
		require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, name+".bundle.json"), mustRead(t, chained), 0o644))
	}
	write("parent-all")
	*now = now.Add(10 * time.Minute)
	dealRun(t, "note", "--deal", dealID, "--kind", "message", "--input", writeJSON(t, `{"from":"counterparty","text":"Your order has shipped."}`))
	write("parent-part")
	spki, err := x509.MarshalPKIXPublicKey(public)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	dir, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"directory_version": "1", "witnesses": []any{rawKeyRow(endpoint, public)}}, "", "  ")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "witnesses.json"), append(dir, '\n'), 0o644))
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "witness-spki.hex"), []byte(hex.EncodeToString(spki)+"\n"), 0o644))
}
